hook: Smuggle past the herons each turn, pushing your luck on Heat, and even getting caught brings your unit back bigger.
loop: Take optional Runs for goods, each rolling 1-3 Heat
Stop just under your Limit, or bust and get a unit Seized
Clean turns buff the crew; busts buy back Tagged units bigger

growth.line: Team +1/+1 per Clean Run or turn; Heat becomes fight Attack; Seized units regain printed stats each Tag

feel.early: Thin; a Run or two, little growth
feel.late: Run multipliers, big Heat stabs, Nan's huge count

stars.why: A push-your-luck game on one card; Seize it to replay
Takes the seizure for the crew, cools you, keeps Running
Doubles its team buff when Heat lands exactly on the Limit

card_short.u01: Run to grow; all your Runs roll 2-3 Heat
card_short.u02: Clean turn: grows for every two Runs
card_short.u03: Peek your next Heat roll; skipping gives a Jasmine Tea
card_short.u04: After Refresh, Run: buff two random Reed Runners
card_short.u05: Start of Turn, Run: get 1 gold
card_short.u06: Start of Turn, Run: frozen shop unit from tier above
card_short.u07: Takes your seizure, cools 4 Heat, you keep Running
card_short.u08: Each Run buffs a random Runner, more on a 3
card_short.u09: Attack per Heat in fight; grows permanently when Caught
card_short.u11: Clean turn: buff team, twice if Heat equals Limit
card_short.u12: Tagged units cost less; buying one buffs the team
card_short.u13: Your first Run each turn happens twice
card_short.u14: Every Run you aren't Caught on buffs the team
card_short.u15: Start of Combat: team gains Attack per Heat
card_short.u16: Run up to three times, growing each time
card_short.u17: All your Run effects happen an extra time
card_short.u18: Hunker; Heat stab steals kills; Seized units get two Tags
card_short.u19: Start of Combat: grows for every Run this game
card_short.x02: Gentleman Moss and Creel-Weaver stack: first Run triples
card_short.x03: A Seized golden comes back golden, doubled Tag
card_short.x04: Bought-back Seized units sell for 1 and count towards triples

builds.name: Clean runner
builds.line: Stop just short; land Heat exactly on the Limit for Creeler's double

builds.name: Hot and Caught
builds.line: Bust on purpose; Heat becomes Attack, Grisel stabs, rebuy units Tagged

builds.name: Back channel
builds.line: Gold and tier-up units from any tribe; Nan pays off late

liked: Busting is itself a payoff: Seized units return Tagged and replay When played
Slipway Champion and Sergeant Squacco: the whole idea on one card
worries: Old Wick with Gran and Squacco could see five or six clean Runs
Golden Grisel and Hackle grow one unit fast; Pilot may pull curve early
changed: Hothead now grows permanently each time you're Caught
Slipway Champion: you decide after each roll whether to Run again
Grisel's stab is one hit; you choose Run order; Pebble Jack clarified
verdict: Rated 7 fun, 8 distinct; all three reviewers settled; ranked third of its seed. For players who love push-your-luck gambles.
